businesses.business: branded consumer home, wellness and beauty products

offering_description.value: Designs, sources and markets branded consumer household and personal care products, including kitchen tools, cooling and heating appliances, humidifiers, thermometers, hair dryers and grooming tools, and nutritional supplements. Sells mainly to mass retailers, department stores and online marketplaces, and to consumers online. Products are made mostly by third-party manufacturers in Asia.

primary_products.value: kitchen tools and food storage; fans, heaters and air purifiers; humidifiers and water filters; thermometers and health monitors; hair dryers and grooming appliances

customer_segment.value: B2B: mass merchants, department stores, home improvement, drug and grocery chains, warehouse clubs, online retailers; B2C: consumers buying through company-owned websites and online marketplaces

end_markets.value: housewares; home environment; personal care and beauty; health and wellness

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded consumer products sold wholesale to retailers and directly to consumers online; licensing or royalties: licensed brand names used on some products, with royalties paid and received

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets branded products made by third-party manufacturers, sold to retailers and consumers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific, with the US the largest market

specialization.value: related lines: housewares, health and home appliances, and beauty and personal care products sold to the same retailers

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: mass merchants, department stores, drug, grocery, home improvement and warehouse club chains; online: e-commerce marketplaces and company-owned websites; distributors / dealers: distributors in international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety (CPSC), electrical standards, FDA rules for thermometers and supplements, import tariffs and customs, chemical rules

divestiture_lines: P2.9: Divested Mass Market Personal Care Business
